title: Green-Card Priority-Date Wait-Cost Estimator
description: Quantify the financial cost of an EB green-card priority-date backlog: cumulative salary opportunity cost vs. outside offers, career mobility restrictions, H-1B extension fees, and strategies to reduce wait cost — across EB-1/2/3 and all chargeability countries.
data_vintage: INA §203(b) EB category rules; USCIS Visa Bulletin (wait estimates user-entered); AC21 extension rules statutory

mcp_tool_definition.name: estimate_greencard_wait_cost
mcp_tool_definition.description: Estimate the total financial cost of an EB green-card priority-date backlog: salary opportunity cost, mobility restrictions, and immigration filing costs over the wait period.
